class.name: SteamAudioProbeVolume
class.brief_description: A box volume that bakes reflections/reverb data into probes, so [SteamAudioPlayer]s inside it can use precomputed reflections instead of the real-time simulation.
class.description: Generates probes across a box volume - either a grid across floor/terrain geometry ([member generation_type] = Uniform Floor, using [member probe_spacing] and [member probe_height]) or a single probe at the box's center (Centroid, for small simple rooms where one averaged probe is enough) - and bakes a single reverb layer into them: data is calculated with both source and listener at each probe position, then interpolated at runtime from the probes nearest the listener's actual position. Call [code]bake()[/code] after the scene's geometry ([SteamAudioGeometry], [SteamAudioPhysicsSceneBridge], ...) has already registered - baking traces rays against whatever's currently in the SteamAudio scene. Baking is synchronous and blocks until it finishes; there's no progress callback or background baking yet. The baked data is saved to [member probe_data_path] (or, if empty, a path derived from the scene file and this node's name) and loaded back from there at runtime - baking only needs to happen once, typically in the editor. To actually use baked data for a source, enable [member SteamAudioPlayer.baked_reflections] on its [SteamAudioPlayer].

method.name: bake
method.description: Generates probes across the volume, bakes reflections data into them, and saves the result to [member probe_data_path]. Blocks until baking finishes. Returns [code]true[/code] on success.

method.name: get_num_probes
method.description: The number of probes currently loaded or baked. Zero if nothing has been baked or loaded yet.

method.name: get_probe_positions
method.description: World-space positions of the probes generated by the most recent [code]bake()[/code] call in this session, for debugging/visualization. Empty if nothing has been baked yet in this session - data loaded from disk doesn't carry positions back out (the SDK's saved probe batch format has no position-query API), only a freshly-generated probe array does.

members.member: The extents of the box volume, centered on this node.
Where to save/load the baked probe data. If empty, defaults to a path derived from the scene file and this node's name.

How probes are placed within the volume. Uniform Floor (the default) scatters a grid across detected floor/terrain geometry using [member probe_spacing]/[member probe_height] - use this for rooms and corridors the listener can walk around in. Centroid places a single probe at the box's exact center, with an influence radius equal to half the box's smallest dimension; [member probe_spacing] and [member probe_height] are ignored in this mode. Use Centroid for a small, simple enclosed space (a closet, a tiny alcove) where one averaged probe is enough and a full grid bake would be wasteful.
Spacing (in meters) between neighboring probes. Only used when [member generation_type] is Uniform Floor.
Height (in meters) above floor/terrain geometry at which probes are generated. Only used when [member generation_type] is Uniform Floor.
Number of rays traced from each probe when baking. Higher is more accurate and slower to bake.
Number of times each ray bounces off solid geometry when baking.
Length (in seconds) of the impulse response simulated when baking.
Length (in seconds) of the impulse response actually saved at each probe. Can be shorter than [member simulated_duration] to save space.
Ambisonic order of the baked impulse responses.
